name: Starting Over
overview: Starting over in the Christian life involves leaving behind past failures and old ways, as Isaiah 43:18 encourages believers not to remember former things. God’s plan for His people is one of hope and a future, promising peace rather than harm (Jeremiah 29:11). Christians are called to stand firm in the freedom Christ has given and avoid returning to bondage (Galatians 5:1). This fresh start requires faith in God’s character and promises (Hebrews 11:6) and a deliberate effort to cast off sin and persevere in the race set before us (Hebrews 12:1).
